name: deed-page
description: Hosting for AI coding agents. Publish HTML files or a whole static folder to a public HTTPS URL at https://{slug}.deed.page/, then update, version, restore or delete it with the owner token returned on the first publish. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint; no API key is needed to start.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server. The first publish_site call returns an owner token; pass it as the token input (or an Authorization Bearer header) to update or delete that site later.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish files to a live URL at a slug. Returns the URL, version and, on the first anonymous publish, an owner token.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Replace the files of a slug owned by the token, or merge in only the given paths.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Check whether a slug is live and return its URL, version, size and timestamps.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List every live site owned by the token.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Permanently remove a slug owned by the token.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List retained versions of a slug, newest first.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Create a new version whose files equal a retained version.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom hostname to a slug and return the DNS records to create.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the plan, limits and number of sites the token owns.

examples.title: Publish a page
examples.description: Publish a generated HTML page and get a public link
examples.prompt: Build a one-page launch checklist as HTML and publish it with deed.page, then give me the link.

examples.title: Update a published site
examples.description: Change a site that was published earlier with the saved owner token
examples.prompt: Update my deed.page site launch-checklist with the new version of index.html.
